notes.title: New Game Update Just Uploaded
notes.content:
What's new with this update:
Improved switch camera mode, pressing Z key will switch between 2 different camera views
Default game control keys now can be remapped
Added a new custom cursor arrow
Added a new in game menu, now if you press Esc key while playing a game level, a pop up menu will prompt you if you want to quit the game or not. Warning, if you quit the game in the middle of a level your current level progress will be lost. All game progress is saved only after a level is completed.

Coming soon: 
A new game level is almost ready but will be added to the game with the next update that is planned quite soon.

notes.title: New Update to version 1.7.5 Uploaded
notes.content: A new update has been uploaded today. New ingame features have been added, now the game has a new score page displaying overall player score, latest level ranking and player overall ranking. Also new InGameAchievements have been added to the game, collect as much items as you can and get the best score in each game level to unlock them.
